race.title: From The Horses Mouth Podcast Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Preference is for IFIWEREARICHMAN , who has looked in good form over hurdles this season without being seen to best effect. He could be ready to open his account for the campaign racing from 8 lb below his mark over fences, though Ace of Spades isn't taken lightly for the Skeltons with his reappearance run behind him. Rambo T could also be in the mix. IFIWEREARICHMAN (IRE) ACE OF SPADES (FR) RAMBO T (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Ace Of Spades (4/1), Gold For Alec (5/1), Rambo T (5/1), Geezer Rockstar (8/1), Horaces Pearl (8/1), Ifiwerearichman (12/1), Aimeric (14/1), William Yeats (14/1), Wonderful Eagle (14/1), Black Bamboo (16/1), Sir Galahad (20/1), Lucky Lyreen (20/1), Moon Mission (25/1), Margaret's Legacy (25/1), Hartur D'arc (33/1), Blizzard Of Oz (33/1)
